hunt.name: N-able N-central Tunnel and Payload Persistence
hunt.description: This hunt targets the endpoint-visible persistence mechanisms observed in the September 2026 N-able N-central exploitation campaign. It specifically monitors for the creation and execution of svchost.exe in user-writable paths like the Documents folder, and the execution of the Cloudflare tunnel client (cloudflared) with a known malicious account tag. The hunt uses parallel execution to check process rarity, known C2 network connections, and file activity, followed by an agent triage to weigh overlapping indicators on a single host.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, package_name, package_version, vendor_name FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE (LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%n-central%' OR LOWER(vendor_name) LIKE '%n-able%')
config.description: Identify hosts running N-central software or agents to prioritize persistence hunting on the most likely targets.
config.expected_signal: A list of hosts acting as RMM servers or managed endpoints. Silence means no N-central assets were detected.

primitive_config.label: Scope N-central Infrastructure
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, package_name, package_version, vendor_name FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE (LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%n-central%' OR LOWER(vendor_name) LIKE '%n-able%')
primitive_config.expected: A list of hosts acting as RMM servers or managed endpoints. Silence means no N-central assets were detected.

config.content: SELECT LOWER(process_path) AS path, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS host_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_process_activity WHERE LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%svchost.exe' AND (LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\\documents\\%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\\users\\public\\%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY LOWER(process_path) HAVING host_count <= 3
config.description: Find instances of svchost.exe running from user-writable paths, a key indicator of the dropped payload.
config.expected_signal: A binary named svchost.exe in a user path, seen on very few hosts. Silence means no such process is currently active.

primitive_config.label: Rare svchost.exe Paths
primitive_config.content: SELECT LOWER(process_path) AS path, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS host_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_process_activity WHERE LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%svchost.exe' AND (LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\\documents\\%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\\users\\public\\%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY LOWER(process_path) HAVING host_count <= 3
primitive_config.expected: A binary named svchost.exe in a user path, seen on very few hosts. Silence means no such process is currently active.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_path, process_cmd_line, user_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%cloudflared%' OR instr(process_cmd_line, '{{tunnel_tag}}') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify the 'cloudflared' process or service, specifically checking for the malicious account tag in the command line.
config.expected_signal: Execution of cloudflared.exe or the presence of the tag '5568cd69c754b392121f1dbb8f900fda' in any command line.
